# Claim Veridicality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ClaimVeridicality`](gmeow-ClaimVeridicality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ClaimVeridicality>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

The veridicality status of a claim — whether it is untrue, licensed-false (fiction, satire, sarcasm), or true. A closed value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses) that makes the licensed-falsehood safety property explicit, separating intentional deception from harmless fictional assertion.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ClaimVeridicality`](gmeow-ClaimVeridicality.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
